definitions.explanation: Describes something that is wildly unrealistic, lacks any basis in fact, or is so far-fetched as to be ridiculous. A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) used to dismiss ideas, stories, or claims as groundless.

examples.japanese: {荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}で、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}しなかった→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The plan was preposterous, and nobody agreed with it.

examples.japanese: {荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一理|いちり}ある→一理ある：15122_ichiriaru⟧。
examples.english: It may sound preposterous, but there is some merit to his proposal.

notes:
USAGE:
This is a ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound). {荒唐|こうとう} means wild and unfounded, while {無稽|むけい} means without basis or evidence. Together they emphasize complete groundlessness.

Typically used as a na-adjective modifying nouns ({荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧) or predicatively ({荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}だ). It carries a strong dismissive tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (absurd story)
- {荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}な⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧ (preposterous claim)
- {荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ (absurd plan)
- {荒唐無稽|こうとうむけい}な⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧ (nonsensical tale)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ばかげた: ridiculous, silly (more colloquial)
- {馬鹿馬鹿|ばかばか}しい: absurd, stupid (stronger emotional dismissal)
- ⟦{無茶|むちゃ}→無茶：13387_mucha⟧: unreasonable, reckless (focuses on being impractical)
